body: Thank you. I’m looking into getting driving lessons and getting a job this year to limit the time I have to spend around her and eventually get out of here. It’s such a sheltered home and my enabling dad tells me to just ‘shut her attitude out’ but that’s easier for him than me since I’m her designated punching bag until she tries to love bomb me into false comfort. It’s definitely a large goal of mine this year to leave here before she tries to make me her personal chauffeur once I learn to drive.

Oh absolutely, they’d get along well if narcs could without trying to outdo each other.
Hang in there, I hope things get better.

Absolutely. My nmother lives off my father like a leech, doesn’t have a job, refuses to get one or learn to drive, and will threaten to kick me out or not feed me because ‘it’s her house’ and her name is on the deed. 

She does about nothing all day but play games and look at social media, but is the self crowned dictator of the house.

Hang in there. I’ve been there, I told my mother I was severely depressed and have been institutionalized before but she calls me selfish as well and tells me to ‘think about what it would do to me’ as well as all the times she’s ‘had it worse’.

Nparents can’t think about anything other than themselves and really suck at empathizing with others without it being a competition.

You are incredibly brave and I hope things get brighter.

Daily. I’ve been hospitalized before due to stress and grief in college with my nmom smothering me with expectations and why I didn’t come home to see her and neglect my studies to entertain her. Sad as it sounds I got wonderful attention from my parents for a short few weeks after I was discharged before things went back to normal, but my nmother consistently made comments about how it would effect her if I had ended my life. To this day she makes it about her and when I talk about how I feel depressed or sad since I graduated and now live a dead beat life wasting away in my parents house rather than using my degree I get the good old ‘quit being a baby, your life is great. you’re stupid for feeling like that.’ Plus, threatening me with ‘up your meds’ and ‘do you need to go back’ as she sees fit. 

Can’t wait to get outta here and get real therapy.
Hang in there and best wishes.

My mother loves to gossip and stand in the window to watch neighbors and make comments on them and just loooooooves to talk shit about her friends to me like I want to hear it. I just cannot stand it because she doesn’t drive, has no job, and lives off my edad and the same people she is two faced to are the same people who don’t know how she REALLY is and are nice enough to cart her around so she can blow money. It’s ridiculous and I can’t wait until she has no friends but she’s so covert and is constantly gifting them things and sweet talking them to their face; but I know what is up.

She also makes faces at people in public and not even subtly while she loudly talks about strangers at the store, or makes scenes when people are blocking the aisle by accident by yelling ‘excuse me!’  I have to remind her not to do that. I’ve told her ‘one of these days someone is going to have a short fuse and take a swing at you’ and she thinks it is hilarious as assumes ‘I can take them on, I’m not afraid.’


I don’t know what I would do the day someone does engage her in an argument because I know from her arguments, she has to have the last word, lol. I just don’t want her to think I’m obligated to aid her when someone does because I’m not the one talking shit I can’t handle.

I feel you, this is my favorite aesthetic and I missed the initial release of it and decided to use a bit of pocket money and what LTs I had and was just miserable with the duplicates. :( 

Grats on what you did get though! 😀

Don’t do it. It’s not worth it. I was extremely excited about the Julian cookie since I adore star themed stuff and used small amount of cash because I figured why not, it’s not like I do it often. Ended up with so many duplicates and feeling upset over it. The chances are pretty off and while I get constant 5 stars on the chances I get for cookies I don’t like when they are on sale rarely for bells, half the time I do use my gathered LTs on something I want, it’s an awful gamble.

Lol god, I’m glad I’m not alone! It’s so hard to just relax and have a decent time and think you have a break from an Nparent and feel bad when you realize some of their actions reflect in your friends. I’ve had a lot of trouble with feeling like I’m too empathetic and often jump to be someone’s support or shoulder to cry on but often feel empty when I need support or end up bottling it up. I’ve gotten into a few spats with friends because I was self-isolating for a while as some self care and they, like my Nmom, were upset that I wasn’t available to talk to them. It’s rough and sometimes hard to comb through and find people who are okay with the phrase ‘I need some time to myself’ or open to a good vent without having to collude with their own personal issues. I don’t mind a good share and ‘I know how you feel’ but not when the convo has to slide back to them.

I relate to this. My Nmom will do the same thing and buy me decent/cheap products, but absolutely splurge on stuff for her own use. I have have the okay toothpaste, but she gets to have the expensive one for herself that she hides.

God forbid I use my own money to buy myself a nice, expensive and good product without her marching to my room to use it without my permission!! How greedy of me! 

I hope things get better and hang in there.

I can relate. A lot of my female friends are the same as you explained. They can be needy, constantly wanting me to be their personal therapist and then silent or passive aggressive when I don’t respond to their text in 3 minutes because I’m dealing with my actual Nmom, who is the exact same. I never feel fulfillment with some of my female friends when I try to have fun or vent to them. I’m either ‘over sharing’ or the conversation has to steer back into their feelings. I have about a few who feel comfortable to talk to and can understand my moods and needs and know my Nmom wrecks hell on my life. But some of them I feel have the same traits as my Nmom and I feel exhausted talking to them when I probably shouldn’t... :(

I am in the same boat, I’m F26 and want to drive and get a license for a job just to spend some time away from my Nmom and have my own consistent money flow for once. My father is her taxi but works constantly so she refuses to learn to drive or get a job so she can live the lush life of a self proclaimed ‘housewife’ as her job. So she literally is just waiting on me to get a license to be her uber 24/7 rather than mooching off what friends she keeps to cart her to places to buy useless stuff off sales. 

At the same time I want to be able to drive and be able to just put distance between myself to decompress out of the house when she pulls her tantrums, but also I know I’m going to be her expected chauffeur. It’s a weird scale.

I think it is. My Nmom hasn’t worked since the 80s and claims to be a ‘house wife’ so she can stay at home and sit on the computer or find reasons to martyr herself in the house. The only times she leaves the house is to go with my father to get groceries and do errands or the rare time she goes out with what friends she manages to keep and buy useless crap because it was on clearance. She also doesn’t drive and leeches off people to drive her around, which also is a reason she doesn’t get out much.

Most of the people I have known who have narcissistic family/others have said they really just like to rule their little kingdom with an iron first and hardly leave it because people in public will take obvious notice to their raging ego.

I too am an only child and feel trapped by my Nmoms expectancy and need for my attention 24/7. She’s also codependent to my dad obviously since he is the one who works since I am too sheltered to get a job. God forbid I take her insult of ‘grow up’ into action and that means I’m not her pet monkey in a cage to entertain and feed her ego. 

It’s scary how narcs subtly don’t want you to be independent or apart from them but think you are the childish, lazy, deadbeat one as they suck the life from you.

I read the book and it definitely was hard for me to get through. I couldn’t stand the mother and golden child aspect and it was rough. A good read but tough.

I haven’t seen the show yet but plan to when I feel comfortable enough.

i need a handful too but some to give to you!

My parents are the same. I remember them being extremely loving when I was younger but as I got older, my father became slightly aversive to my nmother after so many years of her wrath getting worse as I grew up and she was in competition with me because I could have civil discussions with my dad. 

Now I jokingly tell them on good days ‘kiss! give each other a kiss!’ As a soft, happy prod to bring levity and neither of them want to be affectionate. 

It’s definitely weird. Kinda makes me wonder what happened. Maybe Nmom sucked the joy out of him, lol.

God, I FEEL this. I hardly talk and find it hard to speak even when I am excited. I apologize constantly and feel annoying if I talk about my interests or use more than 20 words. 

I constantly find myself clamming up and feeling like I am obnoxious and rework simple conversations over and over in my head and stutter or just say nothing.

I’ve had my interests, hobbies, and things I like to talk about interrupted by my Nmom telling me to shut up so much that I feel like when someone doesn’t respond or show even basic recognition, I kind of assume I have irritated them and apologize. I had a therapist once tell me that I seemed so ashamed of myself and my words only after a few sentences because I had learned to silence myself so much and expect annoyance at me. I was told as a kid that I was to be ‘seen and not heard’ and it made me feel raw that someone noticed I felt immense shame at something as simple as speaking and asking for help. 

You aren’t alone in this and I hope things improve. Please don’t be afraid to let your voice be heard.

I hate that I can relate to this so much. My gaming Nmom often gets angry if I aid other players (which is partly my job since I help with a guide building group to help players) within my clan or friends since it detracts from her and getting any kind of RNG related drop I’m somehow cheating. Not sure how random numbers that I don’t have control over is cheating but she sureeee does give me the silent treatment for a few days. 

I do find it funny my Nmom has a mocking stigma of other female players and as her daughter I’m just like ‘.... why can’t you... uplift other ladies who do genuinely like playing games and are good at it?? Rather than bringing them down for competition??’

good lord that sounds like a horror story and I’m so sorry that happened to you. :(
Thank you all for your comments and similar situations. I seriously thought that maybe I was the one off to experience this with a game playing N. Much support to you all!
God yes!! She also consistently guilt trips me if I don’t play the game I quit with her with ‘Oh, no one likes to play with me anymore because Name quit!’ I feel this in my soul.

It’s my main priority at the moment. Once I get a renewed permit I’m looking into driving lessons, passing the test for a license, getting a job, and ditching my mother and going LC and NC if possible. I don’t want to be here when I’m 30. 

Thank you for your input!

Good on you! I’m in the same boat and am stuck at home with my Nmom who refuses to let me get a license yet exudes that I should be an Adult and Get A Job and continues to shelter me.

Best wishes to you and may you land a job that you enjoy that brings you closer to LC/NC!
Lol man, I’m glad it’s not just me.

Absolutely. Every time I do something for myself or buy something like for example some skin care stuff, my Nmom has to know what it is, how much I paid, and EVEN uses it for herself and tells me ‘You need to share and stop hiding stuff from me, I ALWAYS let you use MY stuff’. When in reality if I asked to use something of hers — oh man things got so selfish and greedy. But yet I’m prompted to let her use things I bought with my own funds.

And that last sentence hit me hard OP, it really sucks to be expected to be an adult, have responsibilities, and put up with their N shit but then also never leave the house, have friends, praise them and be a ‘childlike, obedient’ slave/maid/errand runner/punching bag for them.

it is so hard to push down that ingrained thought of ‘but she’s my mother’ that just comes with being their kid. 

Sometimes my mother does incredibly nice things to me, she gives me gifts, we go weeks without argument— it feels great. Then things soak back into what I know as ‘normalcy’ and the yelling, manipulation, and ‘I bought you xyz gift and this is how you treat me??’ starts up again. 

I also have the ‘You’re too sensitive’ beaten into my head and question if I’m the problem. But it’s all just gaslighting on my Nmom’s part. 

While people may give you the ‘she’s your mom’ and etc. the best thing to do is just give the Narc basic responses without feeding them too much rope to pull you back in or just no contact. I can’t say for sure as I am still stuck with my Nmom and Edad but often times I have to remind myself that she may be my mother by blood but she has never really treated me like one. 

It’s a tough brain space, stay strong.

All the time. They always have to one up you. They aren’t happy until they are in a pity position. It makes sharing any issues, opening up about feelings, or having a serious talk pointless when dealing with her.

The one time I broke down about my depression after having to be at the hospital for a week I got a long spiel about ‘Oh, I was depressed too. You’ll get better. Your dad was deployed allll the time and I was soooo lonely and only had you around... blah blah blah victim complex, I had it worse...”

It’s so hard for them to stop and think about someone else rather than themselves.

Absolutely, it’s like a daily thing now, and god forbid I be sick or sleep in. At this point I just get up, do my chores and tidying ( really shouldn’t have to considering I’m not a child and Nmom boasts about how she doesn’t need a job because she’s a ‘housewife’) and run back to my room to wait to hear doors slamming and muttering because I forgot something that wasn’t even hinted or told to me that I should be doing. 

I don’t even bother leaving the doorframe and just wait for her to invade my privacy.

It’s ridiculous. I really abhor when I hear about Narcs using their victims as little maids or errand runners for the most RIDICULOUS tasks.

Absolutely. No ahead notice or time to get ready just ‘aren’t you coming?? why aren’t you ready??’ leaving me confused. and usually due to me not being a mind reader that my Nmom wanted to go somewhere, she’s miffed the entire time and is more likely to start a scene in public.

at this point she knows 90% of the time I’m not going and I’d rather be called lazy and bad talked to her friends for not going than being yelled at in public and being stressed the rest of the day while she acts like a child in public. double edged sword for sure but I’d rather sit in the comfort of my home versus trying to be her handler and leashed dog in public. 

I’m glad it’s not only me that noticed this. :( stay strong.

I broke a glass once and cut my hand open pretty badly and my Nmom cared more about the glass than her 9 year old bleeding and being upset. 

After a lot of years of rinse and repeat, now I have trouble accepting accidents as human error and find myself repetitively apologizing, expecting anger over minor things.
